segments.name: Post-secondary education
segments.description: Operates the University of Phoenix, providing flexible degree and certificate programs primarily to working adult learners and employers.
segments.evidence: The University currently offers a number of degree-granting and non-degree certificate programs across a wide range of disciplines, including business and information technology ("IT"), health professions, social and behavioral sciences, education, nursing, doctoral studies, and general studies.

revenueModel.text: Students and employers pay tuition for degree and non-degree programs, with many students receiving discounted tuition benefits under employer relationship programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Many of our students receive discounted tuition benefits under programs offered through our employer relationships, which are classified as B2B enrollment.
